definitions.population: One row per source record from the complete benchmark-index.json; no name-based merging or surface filters.
definitions.numeric_scores: Finite numeric observations from each record's own detail shard, unique by obs_id; retained with citation IDs.
definitions.model_count: Distinct source model_id among numeric observations on this source record; incomplete IDs or no numeric observations yield null.
definitions.document_count: Distinct cited document IDs per source record; no citations yields null, not zero adoption.
definitions.percent: Numeric record with explicit percent unit, known score direction and all values in [0,100]; this does not establish matching protocols.
definitions.other_numeric: Numeric scores on other or unverified scales, retained in the census.
definitions.release_known: Valid benchmark release date in the catalog; no model-date or crawl-date substitution.
definitions.links: Catalog presence flags for paper/repo/dataset links, not verified current availability or license grants.
definitions.dates: Counts by recorded score-date precision, not inferred evaluation or release dates.
definitions.figure_order: Source order in sources, then exact source key; each record occupies one linked dot, without score or date filtering.
